<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex1301_10202023-06-285" status="reviewed"><lg><l>de dag rjes <lb n="1b4"/> zhugs dpyad la ltos myed par ||</l> <l>rnam 'jig sdud dang gzhung don gsal byed pas ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3773">ston de</rs>'i dgongs pa bde blag nges 'gyur ba'i ||</l> <l><rs type="work" ref="db:4550" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">legs bshad bsdus pa'i ti ka</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">bdag </rs>gis bya ||</l></lg><note type="translation"/>I will compose a commentary that is the Summary of eloquent elucidations
Such that the intention of this teacher can be ascertained easily,
Without depending on the analysis of those who follow the former,
By including their destruction and clarifying the meaning of the text.
</seg></TEI>
